name: Feral Gargun
printedArtCredit: Thomas Baxa, p. 90. David Day, fallen-log illustration p. 91.
sourceDistinctions: The full package has two Monstrous Humanoid Hit Dice and LA +2. The optional four-level monster class reaches that package.
At stage 2, use 1d4 claws and actual Medium size for opposed checks. Stage 3 adds 1d6 claws and Powerful Build.
Goliath Blood applies to race-keyed effects. The full Feral Gargun profile supplies its own natural attacks, resistances, and racial progression.
Original adventure examples appear separately in Raiders of the High Citadel. The staged NPCs are original.
portraitForm: Sava of Rethma, an original Feral Gargun Ranger
